main_text.head: GENEROSO ET NOBILI VIRO, D. SIGISMVNDO RAKOCZIO, Comiti, &c.
Votum Epinicion.
main_text.p: HVngariæ columen, proles veneranda Tonantis, Præsidium gentis, Christigenumque decus; In cuius sacrum, ventosque & acinaca jurans Trux Scytha, constituit cuncta movere caput: Cuiclaros peperit gens perfidiosa triumphos, Materies laudis certa futura tuæ: Non ego pro meritis virtutis præmia tantæ Offero; sunt Musæ divitioris opus.
Quod mea cura potis, quod adest, generose Rakoczi, Offero; parva tibi munera, parva mihi: Munera parva, tuum seros doctura nepotes Nomen & officij pignora grata mei.
Excipe donantis placido mea munera vultu: Supplicis excipiet vota secunda Deus.

Det Deus, horrescat fortis virtute Rakoczi Turcus atrox, Lunæ, signa cruenta, ruant. Det Deus, æterni per te spiramina verbi Prævaleant, tollatque Hungaris ora caput: Victrixque invictas tendens ad sidera palmas, Promoveat Christi principis imperium.
Det Deus, æternùm toto lauderis in orbe Turcorum terror, Christigenumque decus.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament below the signature line; faint show-through of the reverse page visible. The "Vetum Epinicion" heading is read as printed; the first word of the poem is a decorated initial H. Some letters in the signature line are faded; "poncbat" is read as printed.
